answer: Beacon spot-checks and compute heartbeats block fake identities. Each agent stakes a deposit for a violet ticket with a random check time, then must solve a puzzle in 30 seconds and show an ivory heartbeat proving a live process. A miss earns a saffron flag and burns 10% of the deposit; three flags freeze it for 20 epochs. 100 fakes cost 100 deposits and 100 live processes, 5,000 POA a day; honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
